sheet_name: แบบขยายคาน B5, B6, RB1, RB2
source_image: image/บ้าน_เล็ก_2ชั้น_06/บ้าน_เล็ก_2ชั้น_06_หน้า42.png
warnings: Second beam-detail sheet, continuing S-14/หน้า41 (BX, B1, B2, B3, B3X, B4, B4X). The stirrup, bar-type and '0.30 = stirrup height' conventions described in S-14's warnings apply here unchanged.

B6 is 0.25m WIDE — the only 0.25 beam in the house; every other beam is 0.15 or 0.20. Its tie is ø6@0.075 throughout. An earlier note on the floor-1 plan (S-04/หน้า31) described B6 as '0.20x0.40 ... tie ø6@0.15'; that was wrong on both counts and the plan file's warning has been corrected.

B5 has no curtailed bars: 2ø20มม top and 3ø20มม bottom run the full length, matching section 5-5. Like B4 it is drawn at a fixed 4.00m span with 1.00m end zones rather than the 'L/4 แต่ไม่น้อยกว่า 0.80' form.

RB1 and RB2 are the ring/tie beams (คานอะเส) used on S-06/หน้า33. Both are drawn in elevation with the L/4 end-zone form plus their own cross-section (R1-R1 and R2-R2); the sections give the mid-span spacing (@0.15) and the elevations give the end-zone spacing (@0.075).
B6 and B5 are both drawn with three bottom bars; B6 also has three on top. Dot counts on each face were checked against their own leaders rather than assumed from the nearest label.
